renderedFields.description:
This task is to fix the issue demonstrated by the following steps:

  • Start Fedora
  • Navigate in the browser to the root of the repository
  • Expand the "Properties" pane of the root
  • Click on the "fcr:tx" link presented in the triple:
    • <> fedora:hasTransactionProvider http://localhost:8080/ff/rest/fcr:tx
  • BOOM!

This behavior is likely related to: https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2387
